purpose: Frozen DA/FHS5 topology x uniform/optimized initial-state four-arm post-hoc ablation; supplement only missing uniform held-out runs
interpretation: Exploratory post-hoc supplement on already inspected parent samples; not new preregistered confirmation, pure-topology causality, or Dirichlet imbalance sensitivity
uniform_rule: Existing node_budget_capital_state: split each node's fixed 120 units by incident degree, floor division plus canonical edge-id remainder; positive coordinates required
held_out_rule: Reuse exact saved request tuples and original request-indexed route-choice tickets. Do not generate new test seeds or train topology/capacity again.
optimized_rule: Reuse saved optimized states and audited held-out endpoints; never rerun optimized arms merely to obtain uniform comparison
dedup_rule: Execution may reuse only exactly identical nodes, initial-state balances, requests and routing-root-seed. Preserve every logical arm and provenance; identical paired outcomes remain data, not extra replicates.
checkpoint_rule: Atomic gzip JSON envelopes every <=100 requests, complete frozen-core chunk validation, state/outcome/hash chain, source/config/runtime binding; PAUSE stops workers and dispatch at safe chunk boundaries
weights: Equal traces within parent, 20 parents per model, equal 3-model means. Never pool phases/sizes or treat four arms as independent parents.
intervals: 80 combined-scope pointwise unadjusted 95% intervals; inverse ECDF ranks 500/19500. Additional 160 scope estimates descriptive only. Shared stratified parent indices across all arms and endpoints; interaction computed within each resample.
preserve: All requests after first failure still simulated
Full per-request route/search/depletion witness and final states
Success count/value, route-arity histogram, traversal/participant/quadratic/unique costs
Per-node budgets fixed; per-hyperedge totals may change with allocation, so not a pure fixed-edge-capacity experiment
